task_description: Remove clouds from optical remote sensing images to obtain clear imagery
solution_steps: Identify the presence and density of clouds in the input image
Apply cloud_removal tool to generate a cloud-free image
Verify the quality of the cloud-removed result
Report the processing results to the user
tips: Cloud removal works best on images with less than 80% cloud coverage. For heavily clouded images, consider multi-temporal compositing.

task_description: Enhance image quality by removing haze, noise, or improving resolution
solution_steps: Assess the image quality issues (haze, noise, low resolution)
Apply image_dehazing if haze is present
Apply image_denoising if noise is detected
Apply super_resolution to enhance spatial detail if needed
Compare before and after images to verify improvement
tips: For best results, apply denoising before super-resolution. Dehazing should be applied first if haze obscures image details.

task_description: Detect and locate specific objects (vehicles, ships, aircraft) in remote sensing images
solution_steps: Determine the type of objects to detect from user requirements
Choose horizontal or rotated detection based on object orientation needs
Apply the detection tool with appropriate confidence threshold
Count and summarize detected objects
Report detection results with bounding box coordinates
tips: Use rotated_object_detection for objects with arbitrary orientations (aircraft, ships in harbors). Use horizontal_object_detection for upright objects.

task_description: Analyze SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) images for object detection or classification
solution_steps: Confirm the input image is a SAR image
Apply sar_object_detection to find targets
For aircraft targets, apply aircraft_classification_sar to identify aircraft types
Interpret SAR-specific signatures in results
Report findings with SAR-specific context
tips: SAR images have different visual characteristics than optical images. Bright spots indicate high radar backscatter. Ships appear as bright point targets on dark water.

task_description: Classify the overall scene type of a remote sensing image
solution_steps: Load the remote sensing image
Apply scene_classification tool
Analyze top-k prediction results
Report the predicted scene category and confidence
tips: Scene classification is sensitive to image resolution and scale. Provide the full scene image rather than cropped regions for best accuracy.

task_description: Perform pixel-level land cover classification of remote sensing images
solution_steps: Apply semantic_segmentation to the input image
Analyze the class distribution in the segmentation map
Calculate area statistics for each land cover class
Report the dominant land cover types and their spatial distribution
tips: Semantic segmentation provides per-pixel classification. Use it when you need detailed spatial distribution of land cover types.

task_description: Extract and map building footprints from remote sensing imagery
solution_steps: Apply building_extraction to the urban/suburban image
Analyze building footprint results
Calculate building coverage ratio and count
Report building extraction statistics
tips: Building extraction works best with high-resolution imagery (< 1m GSD). Low-resolution imagery may miss small buildings.

task_description: Extract road networks from remote sensing images
solution_steps: Apply road_extraction to the input image
Calculate total road length and density
Identify major road types (highways, urban roads, rural roads)
Report road network statistics
tips: Road extraction benefits from high-resolution imagery. Look for linear features with consistent width and color.

task_description: Identify and classify aircraft types in remote sensing images
solution_steps: Apply horizontal_object_detection or rotated_object_detection to find aircraft
For each detected aircraft, apply aircraft_classification_optical (or SAR variant)
Report aircraft types, counts, and spatial distribution
Cross-reference with knowledge base for aircraft specifications
tips: Aircraft classification accuracy depends on image resolution. High-resolution imagery (< 0.5m) provides better classification results.

task_description: Assess damage in disaster-affected areas using pre and post-event images
solution_steps: Obtain both pre-event and post-event remote sensing images
Apply change_detection to identify changed areas
Apply damage_assessment for detailed damage severity classification
Calculate damage statistics (area, severity distribution)
Report findings to support emergency response
tips: For rapid damage assessment, prioritize areas near known disaster epicenter. Consider SAR imagery for cloud-covered disaster areas.

task_description: Count specific objects (vehicles, aircraft, ships) in remote sensing images
solution_steps: Identify the target object category from user requirements
Apply object_counting tool for efficient counting
Optionally verify with horizontal_object_detection for spatial distribution
Report total count and density statistics
tips: Object counting is optimized for dense scenes. For sparse objects, use detection tools instead. Consider image tiling for large area analysis.

task_description: Detect land cover and land use changes between two temporal images
solution_steps: Ensure both images are co-registered (same geographic extent)
Apply change_detection with the two temporal images
Analyze change types and their spatial distribution
Calculate changed area and change rate
Report temporal changes with statistics
tips: Use images from similar seasons to reduce phenological change artifacts. Cloud-free imagery is essential for accurate change detection.

task_description: Map land use and land cover types across a region
solution_steps: Apply land_use_classification for overall LULC mapping
Use semantic_segmentation for detailed pixel-level classification
Calculate area statistics for each land use category
Analyze spatial patterns and distribution
Report land use composition and spatial distribution
tips: LULC classification accuracy varies by season. Multi-temporal analysis improves agricultural and vegetation classification.

task_description: Answer specific questions about remote sensing imagery content
solution_steps: Parse the user's question about the remote sensing image
Apply remote_sensing_vqa with the image and question
Optionally supplement with relevant tool analysis
Provide a comprehensive answer combining VQA and tool results
tips: VQA works best for factual questions about image content. For quantitative analysis, combine VQA with specialized tools.

task_description: Answer domain-specific questions about remote sensing, aircraft, sensors, or techniques
solution_steps: Identify the domain knowledge needed
Apply knowledge_query to retrieve relevant information
Synthesize retrieved knowledge into a comprehensive answer
Cite sources from the knowledge database
tips: The knowledge base covers aircraft specifications, satellite sensors, and remote sensing techniques. Use specific technical terms for better retrieval.

task_description: Perform comprehensive analysis of a remote sensing scene including detection, classification, and statistics
solution_steps: First, classify the overall scene type with scene_classification
Perform object detection for relevant targets
Apply semantic_segmentation for land cover analysis
Count specific objects of interest
Synthesize all results into a comprehensive report
tips: For comprehensive analysis, start with scene-level understanding before drilling into specific objects or features.
